## Change and evidence

Describe the defect or measured need, the mechanism/policy boundary, and alternatives.

## Validation

State commands actually run. Distinguish fake Pi, mocked Podman, real integration,
and tests not run. Include regression coverage and migration/rollback impact.

## Review

- [ ] No credentials, private source, transcripts or environment-specific paths.
- [ ] Grants, bounds, cancellation and failure behavior are explicit and tested.
- [ ] No model-specific default, host fallback or implicit promotion.
- [ ] Documentation, dependency lock and compatibility notes match the change.
